headlines.summary: 중소벤처硏, 기업동향 분석 결과 3분기 중기 수출 334억불 최고치 제조업 생산은 전년대비 4% 감소 대출연체 증가…고용·창업도 부진 중소기업계가 역대 최고 수출 실적에도 불구하고 제조업 부진이 이어지고 있다. 사진은 한 섬유공장 모습. [연합] 중소기업 수출이 역대 3분기 최대 실적을 기록했지만 제조업 생산은 감소세로 돌아선 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.summary: 1~9월 국세수입 385조원…전년比 33%↑ 9월 법인세 중간예납 분납분 등 23.6조↑ 재추계 대비 진도율 80.5%…추경比 92.7% "높은 진도율만으로 추가 세수 판단 어려워" [서울=뉴시스] [세종=뉴시스]여동준 기자 = 반도체 기업의 실적 개선에 따른 법인세 증가 등에 힘입어 올해 9월까지 국세수입이 지난해보다 95조4000억원 늘었다.

headlines.title: 서울 아파트도 거래절벽 … 9월 3915건, 전년비 ‘ 반토막 ’

headlines.title: 전세가뭄에 부르는게 값, 서울 임대차 70% 가 ‘ 월세 ’… 집없는 설움 커...

headlines.title: 서울 아파트 평균 월세 1년새 15% 폭등
headlines.summary: 급등하는 월세에 무주택자들 신음 평균 금액 144만→166만원 상승 10%초반대 전세·매매 상승률 추월 ‘노도강’ 16%↑, 외곽 서민 ‘직격탄’ 임대료가 고공행진하는 가운데 지난 1년 동안 서울 아파트 평균 월세가 전세가 오르는 폭보다 가파르게 상승한 것으로 집계됐다.

headlines.title: “ 수도권 7만6700호 공급위해선 토지보상·교통망구축 시급 ”
headlines.summary: ■ ‘10·29 공급대책’ 전문가 제언 “합의 등 지연땐 3기 신도시 꼴” “지하철 등 해결돼야 공급 신뢰” 정부가 경기지역에 신규 공공택지 7만6700호를 공급하고 2030년까지 착공하겠다고 발표했지만, 전문가들은 3기 신도시 토지보상·광역교통망 구축 지연이 되풀이될 수 있다는 우려 섞인 전망을 내놓고 있다.

headlines.title: 가격 오른 배추, 재배면적 증가 … 내림세 무는 감소
headlines.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 진연수 기자 = 올해 가을 배추 재배면적은 늘고, 무는 줄었다. 작년 배추 가격은 오르고 무는 내리면서 재배면적에도 차이가 생긴 것으로 분석된다. 국가데이터처가 발표한 '2026년 가을배추·무 재배면적조사 결과(잠정)'에 따르면 올해 가을 배추 재배면적은 1만3천909헥타르(ha)로, 작년보다 5.5%(727ha) 늘어난 것으로 집계됐다.

headlines.title: 올해 가을배추 재배면적 5.5% 증가 … 가을무는 1.3% 감소
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 국가데이터처, 2026년 가을배추·무 재배면적조사 결과 연도별 가을배추·무 재배면적 추이(2006~2026). 국가데이터처 제공 올해 가을배추 재배면적은 지난해보다 증가한 반면 가을무는 소폭 감소한 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 法 없어 안방 내준 ‘ K-코인결제 ’

headlines.title: 한은 “ 해외 코인카드, 과세 회피 악용 우려 ”
headlines.summary: 해외 발급 이용 현황조차 파악 못해 자료 제출 요구할 법적 근거도 미비 “해외사업자 감독 근거 마련해야” 한국은행이 해외 발급 크립토카드에 대해 자금 이동과 과세 규제 회피 수단이 될 수 있다고 국회에 보고한 것으로 확인됐다. 해외 사업자에 관련 자료를 요구하는 데에도 제도적 한계가 있어 발급·이용 현황조차 파악하지 못하고 있다는 한계도 지적됐다.

headlines.title: 결제 ‘ T+1 ’ 전환, 빨라도 늦어도 ‘ 독 ’

key_headlines.title: Seoul Monthly Rent Surges 15% Annually as Jeonse Era Ends
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment average monthly rent jumped from 1.44 million won to 1.66 million won over the past year, a 15% increase that outpaces jeonse and sales price growth rates. The shift reflects a structural transformation in Korea's rental market as landlords face lending constraints.

key_headlines.title: Government Tax Revenue Increases 95 Trillion Won Through September on Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: National tax revenue for January-September 2026 reached 385 trillion won, up 33% year-over-year, driven primarily by a 52 trillion won increase in corporate tax from improved semiconductor company earnings. The strong fiscal performance suggests robust economic activity in key industries.

key_headlines.title: Triple-Digit Production Surge Led by Semiconductors and Automobiles
key_headlines.summary: Korea's industrial production expanded 1.9% in Q3, marking the highest growth in 15.5 years, while consumer spending increased 3.6%, the strongest in 3 years 7 months. The rebound was driven by semiconductor and automotive sectors, though consumption showed weakness in Q2.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Transactions Plummet 42% to 3,915 in September
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment transaction volume fell sharply to 3,915 in September from 6,796 a year earlier, reflecting transaction cliff conditions caused by tightened lending regulations, land transaction restrictions, and surging mortgage interest rates. Prices marginally rose 0.09% week-over-week.

key_headlines.title: Monthly Rent Dominates National Rental Market at 69.7% Share
key_headlines.summary: Monthly rentals now comprise 69.7% of all rental transactions nationwide in September, with jeonse contracts dropping to 25.7% as landlords face limited access to deposit financing. Regional data shows even stronger monthly rent dominance in non-apartment properties.

sections.Hot Economy News: Korea's economy shows mixed signals as semiconductor-driven growth supports tax revenues and industrial production, but real estate and consumption dynamics reveal underlying structural strains. The transition from jeonse to monthly rental contracts accelerates due to financing constraints, particularly impacting low-income renters in Seoul where average monthly rents jumped 15% annually. While Q3 production reached its highest level in 15.5 years and consumer spending posted strong gains, apartment transaction volumes collapsed 42% year-over-year, signaling market hesitation amid rising borrowing costs and regulatory tightening. Government initiatives now focus on monitoring major national projects including green transformation and livelihood improvements as economic momentum remains uneven across sectors.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's fiscal position strengthened considerably through September with national tax revenue climbing 95.4 trillion won year-over-year to 385 trillion won, reflecting strong corporate earnings particularly in semiconductors. The Bank of Korea maintains policy flexibility as inflation monitoring continues, with policymakers balancing employment gains and asset price pressures against consumer price dynamics. Japan's central bank held rates at 1.25% while officially confirming achievement of its 2% inflation target, signaling potential future rate increases as it transitions from long-standing monetary easing. The U.S. Federal Reserve kept rates steady at 3.75-4.00% despite 3.4% Q3 GDP growth, citing persistent inflation pressures that may warrant additional increases in coming months. Government task forces have mobilized to monitor implementation of major national projects including K-Green Transformation and Seven SEED Projects to ensure policy announcements translate into concrete economic benefits.
sections.Financial Markets: Korean stock markets declined sharply with KOSPI falling 3.48% to 5,730.74 and KOSDAQ dropping 3.83% to 724.38, reflecting broader global market volatility. Domestic fund market net assets contracted 87.8 trillion won (5.1%) to 1.646 quadrillion won in Q3, the first quarterly decline in over four years as stock-focused funds suffered major valuation losses. U.S. Treasury yields remain elevated at levels exceeding equity market expected returns, creating relative bond strength despite concerns about persistent inflation and economic growth contradictions. Risk-off sentiment drove investors toward safer government bond assets, with Korean government bond yields declining across the curve on safe-haven demand. Currency markets saw the won strengthen slightly to 1,334.3 won per dollar, reflecting broader capital flow patterns amid global equity market uncertainty.
sections.Industry & Technology: SK Group completed major executive reshuffles prioritizing semiconductor stability and energy sector transformation, appointing an energy expert as new CEO of SK Innovation to accelerate electrification initiatives and AI-era energy business capabilities. SK Hainíx and other semiconductor subsidiaries retained current CEOs to maintain operational continuity amid favorable market conditions. LG CNS and Samsung SDS both reported strong Q3 results boosted by robust AI and cloud computing demand, with operating profit increases of 15% and growing AI datacenter revenues driving business expansion. Hyosung Heavy Industries partnered with German industrial giant Siemens to develop next-generation digital power grid and AI datacenter solutions for global markets. Hyundai Motor Group began construction preparations for its 9 trillion won Saemangeum AI Valley project, targeting operational launch by 2030 as major technology conglomerates accelerate AI infrastructure investments.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment rental market undergoes structural transformation as monthly rentals now comprise 70% of all lease agreements, up from historically lower levels, driven by landlord financing constraints limiting jeonse deposit availability. New apartment supply concerns intensify with Seoul showing 90 consecutive weeks of price increases despite transaction volumes collapsing, creating scarcity that pushes prices upward even as trading activity plummets. Real estate experts identify Seoul's Yeongdeungpo and Gwangjin districts as priority redevelopment zones, though reconstruction project valuations have already appreciated significantly, forcing practical investors toward villa acquisitions as viable alternatives. Non-apartment rental properties nationwide show even stronger monthly rent dominance with 7 of 8 transactions being monthly leases, indicating the rental market shift transcends specific property types. Concerns mount about future apartment supply given regulatory restrictions on land transactions in Seoul metropolitan areas and tightened lending requirements limiting new project financing.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve maintained policy rates at 3.75-4.00% during late October meetings while signaling potential future rate adjustments and proposed reducing annual FOMC decision-making meetings from 8 to 7 in 2027 and 6 in 2028. The European Union initiated safeguard investigations into imported hybrid vehicle imports from worldwide sources, potentially impacting Korean automaker exports and prompting government analysis of domestic industry effects. U.S. Q3 GDP growth of 3.4% exceeded market expectations, though persistent inflation in personal consumption expenditures continued supporting arguments for additional rate increases before year-end FOMC meetings. Japan's central bank elevated growth forecasts for fiscal 2026 to 0.7% from 0.6%, citing expected benefits from global AI demand expansion supporting corporate profitability. Korean monetary policy increasingly converges with U.S. approaches as policymakers balance employment gains, asset price pressures, and won-dollar exchange rate stability considerations in financial stability assessments.
sections.AI & Economy: LG CNS and Samsung SDS both capitalized on surging Q3 AI and cloud infrastructure demand to post strong earnings, with AI datacenter construction, operations, and server colocation services driving significant revenue expansion in these high-margin businesses. Hyosung Heavy Industries partnered with German technology leader Siemens to jointly develop next-generation digital power grid and AI datacenter solutions, positioning Korean companies within global AI infrastructure value chains. Hyundai Motor Group accelerated its 9 trillion won Saemangeum AI Valley project, breaking ground in March 2027 with full operational targets by 2030, reflecting major industrial conglomerates' commitment to AI ecosystem development. The government's Workforce Development Agency initiated specialized AI job support programs for 2027 to address employment transitions driven by artificial intelligence adoption across economic sectors. Government officials acknowledged mounting youth income gaps and social isolation driven by AI-related job displacement, indicating research into comprehensive income support mechanisms including potential universal basic income frameworks for affected populations.
sections.Others: Big Tech companies including Alphabet and Amazon face cash flow pressures as massive AI investment outlays ripple through financial markets, with revealed capital expenditure scaling deterring investor sentiment across U.S. equities. The government mobilized inter-agency task forces to monitor implementation of major national initiatives including K-Green Transformation, Seven SEED Projects, and Three Livelihood Projects ensuring policy announcements achieve tangible economic results. The Korea District Heating Corporation received prime minister commendation for industrial contributions including domestically developing previously imported industrial heat meters, supporting small-medium enterprise growth and employment creation. Youth disconnection and isolation rates doubled to 5.2% by 2024 from 2.2% in 2022, prompting government welfare officials to research fundamental income security solutions beyond conventional social safety nets to address structural employment challenges. EU safeguard investigations into hybrid vehicle imports signal rising protectionist trade pressures affecting Korean automotive exporters amid geopolitical and industrial policy tensions.
